caption: the luxor rebuild - 3d tracks, sharper curves and the series' visual peak.
about: Luxor 2 (2006) rebuilt the marble line in polished pseudo-3d: tracks curve through the frame instead of running flat, chains split and merge, and the power-ball pool grew into a genuine toolkit. It is the chapter that modernized the formula without bending its laws - and the one that most directly competed with zuma's revenge for the genre crown.
The steam listing still sells the pc build, keeping a live official door on the series' visual peak.
